adjudication.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb, poll_feed parses the configured feed and calls TopicEmbed.import(user, url, ...) for each item without any check that the item URL’s host matches SiteSetting.embeddable_host. TopicEmbed.import only validates the URL scheme via /^https?\:\/\// and does not enforce a host restriction. This differs from the on-demand embed path (TopicRetriever#invalid_host?) which blocks retrieval when the embed_url host doesn’t match embeddable_host, so feed polling can create TopicEmbeds/Topics for URLs that the embed host restriction would otherwise reject.
